facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 02/02/2026 records Niger as having ratified or acceded to the Malabo Convention on 22/02/2022 and deposited the instrument on 16/03/2022, with no signature date shown.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

note: A UEMOA accounting directive, not digital law; the passages name no digital text and state nothing about Niger specifically.
Budapest ratification is a Council of Europe convention (other); Malabo and the AES roadmap are named with no signature, ratification or national effect stated.

facts.fact: Minister Raliou said Niger has ratified the Malabo Convention on personal data protection, one of 13 African countries.
